subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors.
stimulus: Fortune has often been blamed for blindness. (a) ----- blindness and fortune are not (b) ----- blind as those (c) ----- blame their fate (d) ----- do not try to overcome adversities. Neither good luck (e) ----- bad luck has anything to do with the ultimate destiny of a man.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors: (a) But; (b) so; (c) who; (d) and; (e) nor.
